description: Fix mutable default argument bug in append_item
request: The function append_item uses a mutable list as a default argument, so the same list is reused across calls. Fix it using the standard None-sentinel pattern so each call without an explicit list gets a fresh empty list.

snapshot.collector.py:
def append_item(item, items=[]):
    """Append item to list and return the list."""
    items.append(item)
    return items
snapshot.test_collector.py:
from collector import append_item

def test_fresh_list_per_call():
    r1 = append_item('a')
    r2 = append_item('b')
    assert r1 == ['a'], f'Expected ["a"], got {r1}'
    assert r2 == ['b'], f'Expected ["b"], got {r2}'
